# Launchset — full studio context

Launchset is a digital design and automation studio. It combines creative web design with practical systems that remove repetitive work, make decisions clearer and return time to a business.

## Positioning

Launchset is presented as a studio rather than a solo freelance-development service. The work covers customer-facing websites, internal tools, automation and measurement. The goal is not technology for its own sake; each project is framed around useful business value.

## Website work

### Prestige Kitchens

A premium catalogue-led experience for a growing interiors business. The work brings fitted-kitchen and bedroom journeys together with direct product discovery while keeping the buying path clear.

### Vietmed Travel

A calm, reassuring digital journey for international patients considering medical care in Vietnam. The experience explains medical travel, support and next steps in a more human and understandable way.

### Pristine Barbers

A practical growth and measurement project connecting website activity, Google visibility, Instagram and customer actions so business decisions can use clearer evidence.

## Internal tools and automation

### Caple Scrape Review

A staged catalogue pipeline that collects supplier product content, normalises it into a canonical JSON snapshot, exposes it in a human-review interface, prepares images and relational data, and verifies the result before it reaches a live catalogue.

### Lead Audit Review

A deterministic research pipeline that discovers candidate businesses, qualifies and deduplicates websites, crawls relevant public pages, records evidence, applies explainable scoring rules and presents the result in a human-controlled review workspace. Outreach is not sent solely because a score is high.

### Other systems

The portfolio also includes local speech translation, on-device bilingual browser support and reporting access designed to reduce repetitive work while keeping people in control.

## Founder

John Helyar founded Launchset. His experience with dyslexia shaped a habit of breaking problems down, looking from different angles and continuing until a clearer and faster useful solution appears. That perspective is part of Launchset's personal brand and approach to business problems.
